requirement: A showcase-navigation apply refused on its first call is logged as nothing written, not as partly hidden menus

oracle.ref: PR #1744 (fix); fix evidence: dev 25/10/2026, Tracy Business wp7 with Claude Cowork WP 0.18.32: showcaseNav.apply refused with contract_failed ('This site already has a second language… Nothing has been written.') and the provision logged 'apply stopped part-way and the revert did not complete — the menus may be partly hidden'
oracle.invariant: S1: first-call refusal — one '!! showcase navigation:' line naming the plugin's refusal and ending 'nothing was written, the template showcase stays in the menus'; no 'partly hidden' or 'revert did not' text; no showcaseNav.revert call; the contract inspect still runs last; settled as 'failed — …' and the receipt removed, on WordPress and Joomla S1: refusal after a running answer (or a lost one) — still reverted, and a failed revert still says 'apply stopped part-way and the revert did not complete — the menus may be partly hidden'
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: a new site has its template showcase taken out of the menus; skips, losses and refusals are said
an apply refused on its first call wrote nothing
a refusal, an ok that is not true over HTTP 200, or a stall is said, reverted, and the pairing goes on
